Contract version: `1.0`

The `worktree` category defines 4 capabilities: 2 required and 2 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `worktree.create` | required | yes | `branch`, `path` | `path`, `branch` | - | - | Create a worktree for a branch. |
| `worktree.remove` | optional | yes | `path` | `path` | - | - | Remove a previously created worktree. |
| `worktree.list` | required | no | `scope` | `worktrees` | - | - | List existing worktrees. |
| `worktree.prune` | optional | yes | `scope` | `pruned` | - | - | Remove administrative metadata for worktrees whose working directories no longer exist. |
